name: Travelo
summary: Bright tour-operator site in ice blue and deep navy with a tight-tracked Spectral serif, an aerial ocean hero with a floating tour card and a giant wide wordmark, and scroll-pinned promise and process sections.

fonts.pairing: Spectral 400 with very tight negative tracking for headings, Golos Text for body and tracked uppercase tags, one wide techno face only for the wordmark

signature: aerial ocean hero with a white floating tour card (image, name, price, location, rating) on the right
giant wide uppercase wordmark with a registered mark across the bottom of the hero
centred section tags flanked by thin arrow rules
white pill buttons with a small navy square holding a diagonal arrow
imagery: saturated aerial seascapes, overwater villas, mountain and safari scenes, smiling travellers, bright daylight
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 32px side padding, 100 to 120px section padding, 3-column tour grid, 20px card radius with 8px inner image radius
